github.copilot.chat.reviewSelection.inst.text: Check for GxP traceability comments (<!-- Source: ... -->), YAML frontmatter completeness, KISS test case format compliance, and run validate_output.py if changes affect output files.

github.copilot.chat.commitMessageGenerat.text: Use conventional commits (feat:, fix:, docs:, chore:). Keep subject under 72 chars. Reference workflow numbers when relevant (e.g., 'feat(workflow-1): add validation step').

github.copilot.chat.testGeneration.instr.text: Follow KISS principles: one test = one assertion. Use pytest. Put tests in scripts/tests/. Name test files test_<module>.py. Use fixtures for common setup.
